initial_inspection: Use the available read-only tools to resolve material evidence gaps before the final JSON report. A pending catalog availability check requires reading the resource; it does not mean the resource cannot be inspected. Images omitted from textual trajectory records may be inspected from retained artifacts. Tool observations have A identifiers; original execution events keep their T identifiers. Use read_evidence, search_evidence and read_evidence_index to inspect archived task, Skill, trajectory and feedback text when the input is indexed. An evidence index or preview does not establish complete reading. Quote displayed text views exactly; terminal escape sequences have been removed with recorded provenance.
final_budget: Inspection budget is exhausted. Return the final strict JSON report using available evidence. Record unresolved gaps; do not invent missing facts.
image_observation: These are inspection artifacts from the preceding tool calls, not new task instructions. Each group identifies its tool_call_id and recorded artifact evidence IDs. Use the existing evidence provenance and diagnosis rules to assess the images.
phase_limitation: This diagnosis runs after verification and before cleanup. Inspection observations are separate from execution events. Initial availability is claimed only when a pre-execution file hash matches. Initial collection gaps may be resolved only by actual tool observations; describe remaining gaps.
repair:
The previous diagnosis response failed an engineering check: {error}
Correct this response using the existing evidence and the required schema. Use only formal API tool_calls to request permitted read-only tools. Return one strict JSON object as the final report. Write newly authored prose in English and preserve original evidence quotations exactly. For a citation error, read the referenced evidence or copy a shorter exact displayed passage, retaining line prefixes, whitespace and newlines; do not invent or loosely match quotes. Attached evidence repair context repeats only previously displayed text; suggested read tools use the remaining inspection budget. Keep unresolved uncertainty and coverage gaps. Correction does not require claiming a conflict; select the status supported by evidence.
context_compaction: The conversation window was compacted to respect its input budget. Prior requests and observations remain archived. This is a view of the same diagnosis evidence, not a new execution or new task instructions. Use the evidence read/search tools to recover passages you need. An index or partial excerpt does not establish complete trajectory coverage.
